runtime_object.origin: S18 independently received S15 runtime snapshot

S18_SOURCE_IDENTITY.scope: 72/72 S15 files and canonical digest revalidated; this is source identity, not a fresh function receipt.

S18_FUNCTIONAL_RECEIPT.scope: Inherited from S18 report only; S19 did not rerun S18 build, CTest, E2E, TLS, or crash-prefix evidence.

DCF_SINGLE_KEY_PRIVACY.scope: M2B1/v1 key-only replacement maps to BCG+21 Figure 1/Theorem 2/Appendix F.1 under AES-128 PRP and ideal joint random tape. epsilon_RNG_joint is unquantified; concrete channel assumptions are separate.

UCMP_CORRELATED_CONDITIONAL_VIEW_P0.scope: Same P0 key handles both x and y Eval calls; operands, local/peer operand-share frames, and opened comparison bit are conditioned on. Correctness makes the opened bit root-tape independent.

UCMP_CORRELATED_CONDITIONAL_VIEW_P1.scope: Same P1 key handles both x and y Eval calls; party-specific initial control and output-share corrections are included.

POOL_AND_ADAPTIVE_ACCESS_N128_M6B5_V3_M2.scope: Includes used, unused, rejected slots and monolithic package/claim postprocessing; relies on fresh ideal roots and transcript-determined access.

POOL_AND_ADAPTIVE_ACCESS_N256_M6S2_V2.scope: Includes used, unused, rejected streamed slots, segment bytes, leases/restart prefix and transcript-determined access.

SHUFFLE_OUTPUT_COMPOSITION_P0.scope: M2CM/v1 forward/inverse local permutation and fresh pad simulation under approved wire-level masked-frame L and ideal private authenticated channels.

SHUFFLE_OUTPUT_COMPOSITION_P1.scope: Separate P1 simulation, including P1 output-share direction and crash-prefix local artifact.

JOINT_PARTY_VIEW.scope: Conditional simulator/hybrid is documented for each party; ideal private authenticated channel has epsilon_channel=0. It is not yet reviewed by a separate non-author cryptographic reviewer. Concrete TLS channel advantage and epsilon_RNG_joint are unquantified; wall-clock timing is not measured.

NON_AUTHOR_CRYPTO_REVIEW.scope: A reviewer who did not write this conditional-view argument must check theorem quantifiers, conditioning, pool hybrids, shared-Pi shuffle simulation, and orphan-share crash handling.

CRASH_ABORT_OUTPUT_VIEW.scope: Only S18 tested no-complete-mask prefixes are inherited. A late prefix can leave one party an 8-byte local XOR share. No atomic/all-or-nothing publication claim.

REPRODUCIBLE_ATTACK.scope: No reproducible distinguisher or exploit was identified in this review; absence of an attack is not a proof.

RUNTIME_DEFECT.scope: No reproducible code/contract defect found; runtime unchanged and no regression run required by this review.

SECURE_ALIAS_READY.scope: Keep EXPERIMENTAL; conditional assumptions unquantified and a non-author review is outstanding.

V3_V4_PERFORMANCE_STATUS.scope: M6A V3 remains OPEN; V4 remains NOT_ALLOWED; formal LAN/WAN matrix not run.

security_assumptions: AES-128 is a secure PRP for the five distinct fixed AES inputs used by the G expander.

epsilon_RNG_joint(schema,T) bounds the whole adaptive getrandom/RAND_bytes tape and all approved party-visible auxiliary information against an independent uniform ideal tape; it is currently unquantified.
Trusted offline T does not collude with either online party; at most one online party is semi-honest corrupted.
Private authenticated channels are ideal in the proof statement. A concrete TLS 1.3 instantiation requires a separate unquantified channel term; external timing is outside the measured scope.

The leakage L includes each transmitted masked operand-share frame and its derived masked ring value, as well as the already approved seed, endpoint, pivot, opened-bit, length, count, and uniform ABORT fields.
